subject: hornbill
title: She Seals Herself Inside a Tree and Leaves Only a Slit

scenes.text: This bird walls herself into a tree on purpose.
The female hornbill squeezes into a hollow and seals the entrance with mud and droppings, leaving just a thin slit.
She stays for weeks, through the eggs and the first chicks. The male has to feed all of them.
He swallows fruit and prey, flies back, and passes each item beak to beak through the slit.
The wall keeps hungry predators out. She is locked in, and that's how the eggs stay safe.
